title: Coffee Canvas
shortDesc: Full-stack coffee customization platform with real-time pricing and CRUD operations.
longDesc: Full-stack web application allowing users to create, manage, and price custom coffee recipes. Features real-time price calculations, intelligent form validation for ingredient compatibility, and dynamic CSS theming based on the user's drink selection.

title: QR Code Generator
shortDesc: Flask web app generating 1,000+ QR codes with improved efficiency.
longDesc: Client-facing Flask application used to generate 1,000+ unique QR codes. Implements automated per-session file management to isolate user data and clean up backend storage, improving system efficiency by 90%.

title: The Spotter Zone
shortDesc: Responsive fitness SPA with authentication and real-time data.
longDesc: Responsive fitness application featuring secure user authentication and real-time database integration via Supabase and PostgreSQL. Implemented mobile-first design with Bootstrap and automated CI/CD pipelines via Netlify to streamline deployments.

title: Employee Management System
shortDesc: Enterprise-ready employee CRUD with Java Spring Boot API and React frontend.
longDesc: Led a 4-person team to build an enterprise-ready management system using a React frontend and Java Spring Boot REST API. Designed a scalable MySQL database schema, applied clean architecture principles, and maintained rigorous Git workflows for collaborative development.

title: Minecraft Server Guide
shortDesc: Complete guide to deploying a modded Minecraft Forge server on Ubuntu.
longDesc: Comprehensive technical documentation for deploying and optimizing a headless Ubuntu Server for modded multiplayer gaming. Covers network configuration (Netplan, NAT traversal), JVM performance tuning, secure remote management (SCP), and system backup best practices.

title: Room To Grow
shortDesc: AI tutoring platform using multi-model routing, CV, and streaming responses.
longDesc: AI tutoring platform leveraging OpenRouter to dynamically orchestrate multiple LLMs (Gemini, Claude). Features computer vision for diagram analysis, real-time streaming responses, and automated parsing of chat context into interactive flashcards and quizzes.

title: TaskMate AI
shortDesc: AI-powered task planner with GitHub OAuth and drag-and-drop prioritization.
longDesc: AI productivity tool that converts natural language into structured tasks via OpenAI's API. Features GitHub OAuth, drag-and-drop UI, and optimized PostgreSQL indexing that reduced query latency by 40%.

title: FanAssist
shortDesc: Next-gen game flow platform with risk modifiers and AI-powered odds explainers.
longDesc: Sports analytics platform utilizing a Python-based Monte Carlo simulation engine to predict NBA scenarios. Integrates AWS Bedrock to generate beginner-friendly explanations of complex odds and features a customizable risk/reward modifier system for live adjustments.
